Please inspect the area and arrange repairs.

issues.title: Garbage accumulating near the community bins
issues.description: Household waste has been accumulating around the community garbage bins, and the waste has not been collected regularly. This causes an unpleasant smell and attracts insects. Please arrange waste collection and clean the surrounding area.
issues.reviewReason: Waste has accumulated at the community collection point. Verify the collection responsibility and arrange waste removal if it falls under community maintenance.

issues.title: Waterlogging caused by blocked roadside drain
issues.description:
Rainwater is collecting on the internal road because the roadside drain appears to be blocked. Standing water makes walking and driving difficult and may damage the road surface. Please inspect and clean the drain to restore proper water flow.

Priority: High
issues.location: Internal road near the second residential lane
issues.reviewReason: Waterlogging may affect residents' access and safety. Inspect the blocked drain and confirm that it is maintained by the residential community.

issues.title: Blocked drain
issues.description: Water is collecting beside the road because the roadside drain does not appear to be flowing properly. The standing water makes the road difficult to use and may create hygiene concerns. Please inspect and clear the drain.
issues.reviewReason: The reported drain blockage requires inspection and cleaning. Confirm internal maintenance responsibility before assigning the task.

issues.title: Cracked road  near the residential blockssurface
issues.description:
Cracked road  near the residential blockssurface
The road surface near the residential blocks has several cracks and damaged patches. These defects make driving uncomfortable and may worsen with continued traffic and rainfall. Please inspect the road and arrange the necessary repairs.
issues.reviewReason: Inspect the damaged road surface for potential hazards and confirm that the road falls within the community's maintenance area.

issues.title: Intermittent water supply in the second lane
issues.description: Residents in the second lane have been experiencing an intermittent water supply during the usual supply hours. This makes routine household activities difficult. Please inspect the supply line and check whether a blockage or distribution fault is affecting the area.
issues.reviewReason: Verify whether the water supply is managed by the residential community or an external provider. Obtain further details before assigning responsibility.

issues.title: Litter scattered around the community garden
issues.description: Plastic wrappers and other litter have accumulated around the community garden. The area looks unclean and needs attention to prevent further waste accumulation. Please arrange cleanup and check whether additional waste bins are needed nearby.
issues.reviewReason: The reported litter requires inspection and cleanup. Confirm that the garden perimeter is a community-maintained area.

issues.title: Drain cover damaged near the junction
issues.description: The cover over a roadside drainage channel near the junction appears damaged and may be unsafe for pedestrians. Please inspect the drain, secure the area if necessary, and replace or repair the cover to prevent accidents.
issues.reviewReason: The damaged drain cover may pose a safety risk. Arrange an appropriate warning and urgent inspection while confirming maintenance responsibility.

issues.title: Flickering streetlight near the parking area
issues.description: The streetlight near the shared parking area repeatedly flickers instead of providing steady illumination. This reduces visibility for residents returning home after dark. Please inspect the light fitting and electrical connection and repair the fault.
issues.reviewReason: The streetlight is located within the residential community. Internal maintenance responsibility should be confirmed before assigning the repair.

issues.title: Large potholes on main road
issues.description: Multiple large potholes have developed on the main road, making travel unsafe for two-wheelers and cars. The damaged surface may cause accidents, especially during rainy weather. Please inspect the road and arrange repairs as soon as possible.
issues.location: Main road near the local bus stop, Thrissur, Kerala

issues.title: Road Damage and Potholes
issues.description: There are several large potholes on the main road in our residential neighbourhood. The road surface is badly damaged, making it difficult for residents to travel safely. Two-wheelers and cars face difficulties while passing through this area, especially during rainy weather when the potholes fill with water and become difficult to see. This creates a risk of accidents and may damage vehicles. The damaged road also causes inconvenience to children, elderly residents, and pedestrians. We kindly request the maintenance team to inspect the location and repair the potholes as soon as possible.
